actual: BUG-1482 full-market reconciliation reaches apply_staged, but assigning connection.autocommit=False while a transaction is active raises psycopg2.ProgrammingError: set_session cannot be used inside a transaction. Reproduced in existing DEV with 000032.SZ after stable double-read; dry-run passes, write rolls back. Fix the transaction boundary without weakening stable-read, hash, coverage, atomic replace, or downstream invalidation contracts; add a real-shape regression test, validate DEV write and idempotency, then apply the already-authorized full-market production reconciliation. No QE dataset/profile changes.
